# Self-hosted AR dependencies

- MindAR 1.2.5, MIT, https://github.com/hiukim/mind-ar-js/tree/v1.2.5
  - Source: official npm `mind-ar@1.2.5` distribution.
  - Used: `mindar-image.prod.js`, `controller-mGt1s8dJ.js`, `ui-fBadYuor.js`.
  - License: `mindar/LICENSE`.
- Three.js 0.160.0, MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160
  - Source: official npm `three@0.160.0` distribution.
  - Used only inside the independent AR page; existing workbench keeps its installed Three version.
  - License: `three160/LICENSE`.

The original photograph was provided by the project owner. No motif name or cultural meaning is inferred. The fixed target was compiled locally from its uncropped image. No image or camera frame is sent to a recognition service.
